label: STAGE 1
head: Denial
sub: "I'm fine. I just need a break from my break."

label: STAGE 2
head: The 3am realization
sub: Lying awake, doing the math on how many years you've wasted.

label: STAGE 3
head: The overcorrection
sub: New planner. 5am alarm. Cold showers. Keto. All starting the same Monday.

label: STAGE 4
head: The crash
sub: Day 4. Whole pizza in the dark. Planner in the trash.

label: STAGE 5
head: Boring consistency
sub: One habit. Same time. Every day. Nobody claps. It works anyway.

head: Most guys *quit* at stage 4.
sub: The ones who make it don't try harder. They start smaller.
